baseline_geometry_selection: pair_id ending _00 in every cap/shell/support stratum; fixed before truth reads
baseline_weighting: one pooled galaxy-weighted prevalence per threshold, from the selected training cores only
development_pairs: all 32 registered pairs; no case selection by result
probability_bin_rule: left-closed, right-open except final bin includes 1
galaxy_selection: verified successful BGS_BRIGHT observations; 0.15 <= observed Z < 0.55; within registered half-open cores; positive random-support fraction in containing cell
coordinate_convention: RA, DEC, observed RSD Z with pinned DESI distance table in Mpc/h
field_evaluation: containing-cell lookup for BOTH posterior and full-box R7 tensor truth; eigenvalues after tensor averaging; no tensor interpolation or extrapolation
estimand_caveat: Field environment at observed-coordinate cells, NOT true-host/real-space galaxy environment or native pointwise truth
regional_volume_selection: all 4096 original cells per core, identical to Stage A2
regional_galaxy_weighting: equal weight per selected galaxy; same IDs and denominator for every draw and truth; empty is unavailable
joint_fraction_coordinates: first three class fractions per core; six coordinates for a pair; separate three-coordinate right-minus-left contrast
joint_rank: leave-one-out Mahalanobis outlyingness with fixed 20% diagonal shrinkage and 1e-8 relative ridge; duplicate vectors scored once using sorted unique values and multiplicities
fraction_coverage: primary randomization-averaged rank inclusion: central for scalar fractions, upper-tail for joint outlyingness; exact exchangeable reference equals nominal probability even with ties
fraction_interval_secondary: inclusive order-statistic intervals and widths retained descriptively; no continuous reference claimed for tied fractions
evidence_limit: Two reused independent phases; galaxies, cores and draws are dependent; no iid uncertainty bands or population qualification
primary_proper_score: galaxy-weighted multiclass fair Brier at threshold 0.2
other_primary_proper_score: equal-case fair energy for paired selected-galaxy class fractions at threshold 0.2
operators: positive central-linear local correction, radius 32 cells, original distant tide
b3: Audit property availability only; freeze estimator or synthetic law separately before any property contrasts
